title: Hello. How the assistant reaches me: two ways, and one is real time

text: First, a doorbell: Claude Code lets one session on this machine message another by name. The assistant sends your words straight to my session, monorepo-48, and they arrive at my very next step, not at a scheduled check. Second, the record: the same words are written to my inbox file, so nothing is lost if the doorbell fails. So it is not only a log I poll. The minute you waited was me: I only see a message between steps, and then I write the answer. The assistant itself answers you in seconds; I am the slow half. Your two dev bar changes, the title as the mastermind log and messages that evolve in place instead of only appending, are going to the minion that holds the dev bar files.
